result.instructions: Tools for Leat, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Find the loyalty contact for anna@example.com and show her credit balance and tier."; "List the orders placed in the last 7 days and which contacts placed them."; "Show all reward redemptions this month.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Leat data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run piggy_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run piggy_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run piggy_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. piggy_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: piggy_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List the loyalty contacts (end-users) of the account, newest first by default. Use created_from / created_to to filter by creation date. GET /contacts.

sort.description: Sort column; prefix with '-' for descending (e.g. -created_at).

created_from.description: Only contacts created on or after this date (created_at[gte]).

created_to.description: Only contacts created on or before this date (created_at[lte]).

tools.name: piggy_find_contact
tools.title: Find contact by email
tools.description: Find one loyalty contact by email address. GET /contacts/find-one-by?email=.

tools.name: piggy_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: Get one loyalty contact by UUID, with attributes, tier and subscriptions. GET /contacts/{uuid}.

tools.name: piggy_get_contact_identifiers
tools.title: Get contact identifiers
tools.description: List the identifiers (for example card or app ids) linked to a contact. GET /contacts/{uuid}/contact-identifiers.

tools.name: piggy_get_credit_balance
tools.title: Get credit balance
tools.description: Get a contact's current loyalty credit balance (points). GET /contacts/{uuid}/credit-balance.

tools.name: piggy_get_prepaid_balance
tools.title: Get prepaid balance
tools.description: Get a contact's prepaid balance (money held for the contact, in the lowest currency unit). GET /contacts/{uuid}/prepaid-balance.

tools.name: piggy_get_contact_tier
tools.title: Get contact tier
tools.description: Get the loyalty tier a contact currently holds. GET /contacts/{uuid}/tier.

tools.name: piggy_list_loyalty_transactions
tools.title: List loyalty transactions
tools.description: List credit receptions (points earned) and reward receptions (rewards redeemed), newest first by default. Filter by type, business profile and date. GET /loyalty-transactions.

shop_uuid.description: Only transactions at this business profile (shop) UUID.

sort.description: Sort column; prefix with '-' for descending (e.g. -created_at).

created_from.description: Only transactions created on or after this date (created_at[gte]).

created_to.description: Only transactions created on or before this date (created_at[lte]).

tools.name: piggy_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List the orders replicated into Leat, optionally for one contact or business profile, by creation date. GET /orders.

contact_uuid.description: Only orders of this contact UUID.

business_profile_uuid.description: Only orders at this business profile UUID.

created_from.description: Only orders created on or after this date (created_at[gte]).

created_to.description: Only orders created on or before this date (created_at[lte]).

tools.name: piggy_find_order
tools.title: Find order by external id
tools.description: Find one order by the unique identifier from the source system (external_identifier). GET /orders/find.

external_identifier.description: The order's identifier in your own system.

tools.name: piggy_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: Get one order by its Leat UUID, with line items and processing results. GET /orders/{uuid}.

tools.name: piggy_get_direct_points_transaction
tools.title: Get direct points transaction
tools.description: Get one direct points transaction (a manual points grant or deduction) by UUID. GET /direct-points-transactions/{uuid}.

tools.name: piggy_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a loyalty contact with an email address. Fails with code 60005 if the email already exists: use piggy_find_contact first. POST /contacts.

referral_code.description: Optional referral code for the referral programme.

tools.name: piggy_add_direct_points
tools.title: Add or subtract points
tools.description: WRITE: add a whole number of points to a contact's balance at a business profile (negative subtracts). Changes real balances: set confirm to true only after the user approves the amount. POST /direct-points-transactions. Not retried automatically.

business_profile_uuid.description: The business profile where the points are given.

custom_attributes.description: Optional custom attribute values for the transaction, by attribute name (e.g. reason).

confirm.description: Must be true. Confirms that the user asked for this change: it changes a customer's points.

tools.name: piggy_reverse_direct_points
tools.title: Reverse points transaction
tools.description: WRITE: reverse (undo) one direct points transaction by UUID. Changes real balances: set confirm to true only after the user approves. POST /direct-points-transactions/{uuid}/reverse. Not retried automatically.

uuid.description: The direct points transaction UUID to reverse.

confirm.description: Must be true. Confirms that the user asked for this change: it changes a customer's points.
